narrative.overview: This is the implemented white-and-green scientific workspace: clear system typography, restrained action color, strong text contrast and minimal decoration. Flat sections, direct controls and explicit measurement units make repeated work easy to scan. The design follows the user's pinned direction rather than a seeded visual world.
keyCharacteristics: White work surfaces on a quiet neutral background.
Green actions, visible focus and plain status language.
System fonts, flat sections and bounded explanatory text.
Measurement imagery and human review ahead of decorative elements.
One supplied light theme; no external font requests.

rules.name: The Truthful State Rule
rules.body: Color accompanies a label, state attribute, border or text explanation; it never establishes approval, calibration validity or scientific units by itself.

rules.name: The Unit Rule
rules.body: Keep px and cm² visible with their respective measurement context. Typography must not visually promote an uncalibrated pixel result as a physical area.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary task sections and actions flat; modal separation and image-tool visibility are the existing functional exceptions.

dos: Do reuse the shared palette, system font stack and observed control primitives across both static mounts.
Do keep task controls, 44px minimum interactive rows and keyboard focus visible at narrow widths.
Do pair scientific states with explicit language, measurement type and units.
Do preserve human approval, native mask geometry, leaf identity and immutable saved history.
Do use real, clearly labeled procedural fixtures when demonstrating a state, without presenting them as biological evidence.
donts: Don't add a second theme, decorative gradients, marketing imagery, external fonts or a frontend framework for visual consistency.
Don't imply cm² from pixel-only analysis or describe projected visible area as true 3D leaf area.
Don't fabricate measurements, growth history, biological accuracy, training promotion or institution data.
Don't remove scale safeguards, approval blockers, tenant boundaries or recovery actions to simplify a screen.
Don't label automated browser evidence as physical iPhone testing, an independent novice study or WCAG certification.
